title: Hold a plumbing licence
what: Carry out plumbing work only under a licence or permit that authorises work of that kind.

laws.title: Plumbers Licensing and Plumbing Standards Regulations 2000 (WA)

sources.title: Plumbers Licensing and Plumbing Standards Regulations 2000 (WA)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out plumbing work of any kind or in any circumstances except in accordance with a licence or permit that authorises the person to carry out plumbing work of that kind or in those circumstances.
